limits: managed.spec.ts test 1 (liftProvider, MultiProviderService and createModels end to end) is covered at component level: exclusion, marker, pool spill and sanitize run through ManagedIntegration directly, not through the lift pipeline, which belongs to the lift lane.

The store file is an in-memory fixture that emits the same lock, read, write and unlock events as the upstream file operations. The upstream parseState validation of malformed files and the atomic temp-file write are not part of this port; the store port owns them.

Native provider responses are scripted fixtures. Rust model auth and auth results keep the apiKey, headers, baseUrl, env and source fields only; unknown extra fields from a native method would be dropped (none appear in the fixtures).
Upstream JavaScript Date is injected as a fixed clock; no real time, network, credential or ~/.pi access occurs.
The host context (ExtensionContext) is modelled by a fixture context type that exposes the model and session id only.
